plan.notes: Source: University of North Florida official Osprey Map (term-by-term sample schedule) for Nursing, https://www.unf.edu/catalog/ospreymaps/2025-2026/Nursing-Prelicensure-Nursing.html, retrieved 2026-10-09. UNF describes the Osprey Map as a sample schedule (not a contract) to be used with an academic advisor; mile-marker courses should be completed before/by the end of that term. CATALOG YEAR: the map is published under UNF's 2024-2025 Osprey Maps path and the page states 'Effective Term: Fall 2024'; the byte-identical page is also served at the 2025-2026 path (UNF has not published newer maps) — recorded as catalog_year 2024-2025. Terms transcribed as Year N Fall/Spring (UNF labels them Terms 1-8; sequence assumes fall start). Summer advisory tables are suggestions only (catch-up/get-ahead options) and are not sequenced. Credit ranges printed on some rows resolved at the catalog minimum per collection standard; UNF declares Total Program Hours: 120 — sequence sums to 108 at minimum elective credits, and free-elective rows carry UNF's note 'If needed for 120 total hours'. Osprey Maps do not publish per-course enrollment prerequisites; mile markers below are progression milestones (minimum grade C).
